title: Unit Event — Our Constellation of Song — Episode1 The Journey Goes On

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has done it at last. They've been signed by a record label! Reflecting on all of the people whose support has taken them this far, Ichika thinks of a way for the band to show their gratitude.

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, it's signed here and all sealed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That should do it for our contract.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They were definitely worried about us signing with a label at first, but I'm glad Mom and Dad agreed to this...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They even said they'd be willing to support us after I told them why we're going pro...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's on top of going through all the fine print and discussing our finances... That really put me at ease.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All that's left is to hand this over to Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And I think it's almost time for me to go.
Where'd I put my phone...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I still have a little time.
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This news headline... A meteor shower...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “The Perseid meteor shower, one of Japan's three biggest meteor shower events, is just over the horizon. This event will go on for about a month, with the peak days being...”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A meteor shower...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me of the time we watched one when we were little...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: There's another one!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We practiced playing that Miku song and just happened to see it happen on our way home...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I couldn't believe how beautiful it was...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But then, in junior high...
We slowly began to drift apart...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure if we'd ever get to watch another meteor shower together like that again...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It'd be great to see another one together.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, we're all here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi! Did you fill out your contract okay? I'll lend you my pen if you forgot to sign anywhere!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-That's okay. My parents went over it with me multiple times at home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, that's good to hear!
Tsukasa and I totally panicked earlier this morning after I found a spot that I forgot to sign.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry, Saki, only you would be so scatterbrained.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Shiho, you're so mean!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we head in...?
We wouldn't want to keep Mr. Shindo waiting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right... Let's go!
Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Okay, I think we're all set.
I officially accept your contracts.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which means...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-We... We're...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. From now on, you'll be producing music under this label. We're looking forward to seeing you get started.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-We did it! We're finally pros...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At the same time... We knew a while back that we'd be doing this, so I don't think this part is anything to get so excited about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh? Then, Shiho, why are you grinning?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I-I'm just... I mean, of course I'm happy for us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe... We finally made it to this point...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm still not sure what it means to commit to trying to become a pro...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I know that I want to be in a band with you, Shiho. I want to perform in shows with you. I want others to be moved by our music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If that means aiming to become professionals, so be it...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We made the decision to go pro that time...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We didn't know if it'd actually be possible, and there were times when we felt unsure of ourselves...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But we really did it...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We won't be debuting for a while... But we should be able to play in front of more and more people compared to before.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And I want to do everything I can to move their hearts... Through our music.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Now, about how things will proceed moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your band will be making its debut as an artist for the label sometime in the future.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, there's a list of preparations that need to be made before you can.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Preparations?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Well, you need to produce some new songs, while we need to promote your name around your debut date.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll start putting some proposals together soon that discuss how you might be billed and such.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Naturally, that includes what kind of band you want to become, how you wish to be perceived and what your music means to you.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You'll need to know those things in order to see what you wish to achieve. And we can't do any marketing if we don't know what you want.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll set up some meetings for us in the future to discuss all of that. So, let's take the time to talk through it all carefully.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Then, that's about it for today...
Again, your contracts all seem to be in order, so I'll be taking them.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: We unfortunately need a bit of lead time with these... So, for now, please keep practicing as you have been.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And feel free to contact me if anything comes up on your end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much for talking with us today!
